# ADR-3064: A06: End-of-life runtime package for service 4

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

EOL runtimes stop receiving security patches.

## Decision

Deployments MUST NOT ship an end-of-life runtime package for service 4 (A06-4).

## Consequences

Upgrade trains are scheduled before EOL dates.
